f27e495d1a9bdb9ebfef793ac6953f48562d7a50:

9278d2fb93c265297f276e45c8ecc3765743c56a:

47704764ad24ed9815da6e9692ad2ebd99f47355:

c5196860a46d0b8db5f555391acf1c2e0d820cfa:

751d81574a3a1bf8103104fa315c8d4ab346e817:
SOURCE: "I cannot give my reasons in detail: but the most general conclusion, which the geographical distribution of all organic beings, appears to me to indicate, is that isolation is the chief concomitant or cause of the appearance of new forms (I well know there are some staring exceptions)."

a987321270c7ac0bc5f66737f7c6215ff26bebcc:
SOURCE: "The more I consider the difference in trouble, between the Floras of Galapagos (or Auckland Isld) & of Fuegia (which is continental) the more convinced I am that the latter are the more polymorphous by far: trouble I mean in determining the limits of species, I still think there is no comparison in that respect:—the question is one of comparison."

RECALL: Hooker expressed the opinion that continental Floras like Fuegia's are more polymorphous compared to island Floras such as the Galapagos, based on the difficulty in determining the limits of species.

RECALL: Hooker apologized for neglecting his duties to old friends, including Charles Darwin and Lyell, because he had been engrossed by the rich flora of the place he was in. Hodgson's extensive knowledge of Himalayan natural history had diverted Hooker's attention from other zoological pursuits.
85cf949537465e5f1038d2a2e537397e8f4d5846:

3a018830810b48be30871aa87fa6976b5b71deca:

2341bc3b9d210cfab91fa287c9c773305bdc1799:

cc6e70de5d4eb274df0b756f0e113d2a95dcafa3:

79f2119515360e2eac9e5488a3e61cc692cc4889:

694ce092fb2b90bbcf02fde5d67696b6f0016dde:
